title: Record production federation terminal reasons in the existing attestation observation
outcome: Record production federation terminal reasons in the existing attestation observation
acceptance: The existing read-only attestation projection retains the first terminal event of the current authenticated context as a bounded structured record containing role, stage, reason, ioKind and incarnation, plus the last accepted heartbeat sequence and the elapsed milliseconds from that accepted frame to the terminal event; absent accepted frames are represented explicitly without fabricated values. Under concurrent terminal events for the same link, or an authenticated context replacement within one transport generation, the recorded terminal is one of the concurrent events, not necessarily the first; exact ordering in those cases is tracked separately. If a context is withdrawn and a reconnect advances the transport generation before its terminal observation is published, the withdrawn context's event may be absent; retention in that overlap is tracked separately. If listener shutdown cancels an installed handoff's attestation after the install publishes and before its proof is observed, that handoff's terminal may be absent; retention across that cancellation is tracked separately.

Only authenticated, fresh and accepted heartbeat frames update the accepted sequence/time pair on either role. Rejected, replayed or mismatched frames and ordinary RPC traffic do not refresh it; the terminal snapshot remains stable after teardown.

Existing owner/context fences, authority decisions, timers and routing behavior remain unchanged. Focused regressions cover both roles, rejected-frame non-refresh, first-event preservation and stale-context exclusion, and the final candidate receives the standard independent review pair and required exact-input validation.
